content.text:
Built **MAGNETAR** in `index.html`—a complete, playable arcade game where you collect 12 star shards, use a rechargeable magnetic field to pull shards and repel sentinels, and try to survive with three lives.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to move; hold Space to use the magnet; P or Esc to pause; R to restart. Touch controls are included for mobile.

I treated the “M” prompt as a theme/title cue. Verified the game loads and runs without JavaScript errors, including mobile controls, magnet charge, and pause/resume.
